Her roommate basically did not even talk to her. Hence, she focused on her studies and especially one biology professor noticed her in her first semester and praised her work. She even read one paragraph aloud as sample for all students in the bio lab class. However, the second semester started badly. Her father lost his job. The nice professor was on maternity leave. Someone broke into her dorm room, stole her laptop, her money card, and a lot of stuff. She did not know whom to ask for help and what to do and started missing class sessions to deal with this. She really had no friends and wondered whether she should just quit and go home. However, Julia decided to stay and try to pull through the hard times.

Her roommate basically did not even talk to her. Hence, she focused on her studies and especially one biology professor noticed her in her first semester and praised her work. She even read one paragraph aloud as sample for all students in the bio lab class. However, the second semester started badly. Her father lost his job. The nice professor was on maternity leave. Someone broke into her dorm room, stole her laptop, her money card, and a lot of stuff. She did not know whom to ask for help and what to do and started missing class sessions to deal with this. She really had no friends and wondered whether she should just quit and go home. Then, the weather turned better and lifted her mood. She went for a long walk in the first warm air.

Her roommate basically did not even talk to her. Hence, she focused on her studies and especially one biology professor noticed her in her first semester and praised her work. She even read one paragraph aloud as sample for all students in the bio lab class. However, the second semester started badly. Her father lost his job. The nice professor was on maternity leave. She really had no friends and wondered whether she should just quit and go home. Then, she got a message from the biology professor on leave. The professor asked her to work in her lab.

Rebecca dates a guy named Martin during her freshman year whom she likes and he makes her happy, but he doesn’t want to have kids so they eventually break up. At age 23, Rebecca marries her amazing boyfriend Steve and they start saving up money for the child she desperately wants. A few years into their marriage, Rebecca has a miscarriage and is devastated, but still wants to have children. On her 36th birthday, after more than a decade of waiting, Rebecca discovers she is pregnant. Several months later, she gives birth to a healthy girl.

They would order a big pepperoni pizza, Tony’s favorite food, and share it among the four of them. This year would be different, however. Tony’s father was away on a business trip and could not make it back home in time for his son’s birthday. Tony had been sad about this ever since his father told him. His birthday just wouldn’t be the same. While he tried to put on a brave face in front of his mother and sister, Tony went to bed almost in tears the evening before his birthday. When he woke up the following morning, his father was on the phone. He wished Tony a very happy birthday. Tony was glad that his father was thinking of him and that he’d have a happy day after all.

They would order a big pepperoni pizza, Tony’s favorite food, and share it among the four of them. This year would be different, however. Tony’s father was away on a business trip and could not make it back home in time for his son’s birthday. Tony had been sad about this ever since his father told him. His birthday just wouldn’t be the same. While he tried to put on a brave face in front of his mother and sister, Tony went to bed almost in tears the evening before his birthday. When they were ready to leave for Uncle Willie’s, his sister came down wearing clothes of his father. She said that if dad couldn’t be there, she’d fill in for him. Tony couldn’t stop laughing: this was going to be a great birthday after all!

They would order a big pepperoni pizza, Tony’s favorite food, and share it among the four of them. This year would be different, however. Tony’s father was away on a business trip and could not make it back home in time for his son’s birthday. Tony had been sad about this ever since his father told him. His birthday just wouldn’t be the same. While he tried to put on a brave face in front of his mother and sister, Tony went to bed almost in tears the evening before his birthday. When they were ready to leave for Uncle Willie’s, his sister came down wearing clothes of his father. She said that if dad couldn’t be there, she’d fill in for him. Tony couldn’t stop laughing: this was going to be a great birthday after all!

They would order a big pepperoni pizza, Tony’s favorite food, and share it among the four of them. This year would be different, however. Tony’s father was away on a business trip and could not make it back home in time for his son’s birthday. Tony had been sad about this ever since his father told him. His birthday just wouldn’t be the same. While he tried to put on a brave face in front of his mother and sister, Tony went to bed almost in tears the evening before his birthday. When they arrived at Uncle Willie’s the next day, Tony spotted his father sitting at their favorite table. His father said he would never miss the birthday of his son and had led Tony into believing that he wouldn’t make it. Although Tony felt fooled, it was one of the happiest moments in his life!

It started to snow outside while they were working so they lit some candles. During a break from studying, they played in the snow and told each other happy memories from childhood. Claire remembered building huge igloos.  Meera grew up in India and only saw snow when she came to study in the States. She was still puzzled by how cold snow really was. They drank hot chocolate together and stayed focused on their test preparation the rest of the night. They worked through the entire set of study guides and finished at 2 am. The test would be early the next morning. It was late, and she decided to call her roommate to meet her halfway back home to be safe.
